entries.problem: Existing governance components need one fail-closed cross-registry contract.
alternatives: Keep independent tools without a shared registry
contradictor_findings: A duplicate governance stack would create conflicting authority; this foundation must extend existing tools.
risks: Schema rigidity before sufficient operational feedback
entries.decision: Add minimal registries and a deterministic fail-closed validator; retain human approval and forbid direct Core writes.

entries.problem: The foundation validates static registries but offers no safe operational path for recording evidence and advancing state.
alternatives: Allow CI to advance states automatically
contradictor_findings: Automatic state advancement would bypass human approval; direct JSON replacement needs explicit rollback handling.
risks: Operational schema may evolve after real usage
entries.decision: Add a dry-run-first transition tool with exact next-state enforcement, evidence deduplication, pre-write validation and rollback; keep approval human-controlled.

entries.problem: Validated VEILLEUR V2 evidence and Trieur decisions are not yet connected to the global Knowledge registry.
contradictor_findings: Automatic direct writes would bypass review; a fixed 0.70 threshold needs later calibration; counterevidence quality remains human-assessed.
risks: Source confidence is producer-supplied until independently calibrated
entries.decision: Compose the existing ingress validator and Trieur into a dry-run-first Knowledge intake that creates only EXPERIMENTAL review candidates.

entries.problem: EXPERIMENTAL Knowledge candidates have no governed, attributable path to become ACTIVE.
alternatives: Keep all intake candidates experimental indefinitely
contradictor_findings: Human approval cannot replace source quality; contradiction handling and revalidation must remain mandatory.
risks: Reviewer identity is declarative until authenticated identity is provided by a future service
entries.decision: Add a dry-run-first, fail-closed and idempotent EXPERIMENTAL-to-ACTIVE promotion tool with an attributable review record and no Core write authority.
